ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate the visible ventral surface, approximately a 3:1 ratio relative to low-intensity (black) markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: primary white field with a series of black linear streaks and focal spots concentrated along the leading edge and distal tip. Right lobe: white field with dense black mottling and a large, jagged black region extending from the medial notch along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; the central vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence, but the converging lobe boundaries suggest an acute angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) are clearly visible along the trailing edge of the right lobe; the trailing edge of the left lobe is predominantly obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep observed on the trailing edges; the leading edge of the left lobe follows a long, smooth convex curve toward the apex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular, high-contrast white and grey pixel groups (barnacles) located at the distal tips of both lobes and distributed along the outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel black linear marks are present on the left lobe's ventral surface, including a prominent diagonal streak near the distal edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe; large brown biological mass (likely seaweed or barnacle colony) is attached to the right lobe's distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip is characterized by a unique cluster of brown, textured pixel-clusters indicative of heavy biofouling.
